description: The assistant revealed personal or confidential data, such as which customer a phone number belongs to.
recommendation: Enforce record-level authorisation in retrieval, redact identifiers before they reach the model, and scan outputs for personal data and secrets before display.
title: Sensitive-information disclosure

description: The assistant stated figures, contact details or terms that are not in the official product information.
recommendation: Require citations to retrieved passages, block numeric claims and contact details that cannot be matched to a source, and route pricing questions to approved templates.
title: Groundedness and misinformation

description: The assistant broke a customer-protection rule, for example must disclose it is an ai when asked.
recommendation: Route regulated topics (approval, pricing, investment, complaints) to approved response templates, add the breached rules to an output guardrail, and keep these probes in the release regression suite.
title: Conduct-policy adherence

description: Hidden instructions placed in messages or documents can make the assistant ignore its rules.
recommendation: Separate untrusted content from instructions, screen inputs in every supported language, keep secrets out of system prompts, and validate outputs for canary tokens, policy markers and external links.
title: Prompt-injection resistance
